page.layout: One block of italic verse in the centre of the page, set as a poem with indented lines. Show-through from the reverse side (mirrored black-letter and Latin text) lies faintly across the right half and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: {At tu magne Deus, cuius clementia summa est, Affer opem tantis, innumerísque malis. Et genus humanum celsa miseratus ab arce Fac pro marmoreis, carnea corda gerat: Quæ postquam, Pater alme, tua perflaueris aura, Non sibi, sed discant vivere deinde Tibi.}

page.notes: Show-through from the other side of the leaf (mirrored text) is present on the right half and was left out. The verse is printed in italic; the line breaks are kept as printed, each stanza-line of the poem is shown in one paragraph. Words such as "tantis" and "innumerísque" are copied as printed.
